blocks.html: The celebrity tanning expertise behind some of Hollywood's most recognisable red-carpet colour is now available for professional salons.
Jimmy Coco Malibu professional solution — {{professional_price}} for {{professional_size}}, with trade support, training and launch assets.

items: Celebrity credibility: a premium name clients can recognise.
Premium client experience: a professional formula and service story built for luxury positioning.
Higher perceived value: a stronger reason to price and present tanning as a premium treatment.
Professional support: trade pricing, training, marketing assets and dedicated stockist help.

blocks.html: I have spent over 20 years perfecting the art of the tan. Malibu is my professional formula, created for artists and salons that care about believable colour and a polished result.
